How these measurements work

Live speed counts visible SDK text only, using UTF-8 bytes / 4 as a rough token estimate; languages and code can differ substantially. No stream is inferred from completed calls.

First visible response starts when the SDK admits this query, not when you click Send. Without deltas, the first nonblank finalized message is shown as an upper bound.

Completed generation estimates (output tokens minus one) / (call duration minus time to first observable output). Provider output token counts can include non-visible work. Model TTFT is provider telemetry, not first visible response.
